remarks: Step into the elegance of a bygone era with this spacious circa-1860 Victorian, ideally situated on more than an acre in the heart of the Village of Youngstown. This spectacular home offers beautiful water views and rare flexibility, as the expansive lot stretches from Main Street through to Second Street, creating endless possibilities for outdoor living, entertaining, or future additions such as a garage, pole barn, pool, or garden retreat. The stately main home features 5 bedrooms and 2.5 baths, showcasing stunning inlaid hardwood floors, generous living spaces, and classic architectural character throughout. Highlights include two staircases, first-floor laundry, updated kitchen and baths, custom replacement windows, and fireplaces in both the living room and kitchen. French doors, a bay window, large enclosed patio with removable walls, extra large patio on the rear of the home and multiple porches provide inviting spaces to relax, entertain, and enjoy sunsets. The thoughtfully designed layout includes a living room, formal dining room, family room, den, bonus room, eat-in kitchen, full basement with all updated mechanicals and a peaceful third-floor space perfect for unwinding while taking in beautiful river views. At the rear of the property, a separate one-bedroom one-bath apartment with its own private entrance, storage and utilities adds exceptional versatility. Ideal for guests, in-law accommodations, a studio, office or potential rental income, it complements the property while maintaining the feel of a grand single-family residence. A substantial barn offers abundant storage and flexible space for vehicle parking, RV, boat storage, equipment storage, hobbies, workshops, or additional creative use. This property is just steps from restaurants, parks, the waterfront, and public boat docks along the Niagara River. Outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate the proximity to nearby state parks offering hiking, swimming, camping, boating, fishing, sailing, and cross-country skiing. Whether you're seeking a distinctive primary residence, multi-generational living, or income potential, this exceptional property offers it all. Also listed as multi-unit B1667728.
